The soundcore H30i wireless on-ear headphones use 40mm oversized drivers and enhanced pure bass to bring your music to life.
A single charge gives up to 70 hours of playback, and a 5-minute quick charge adds 4 hours of listening.
At only 183g, with soft detachable earcups and an ergonomic shape, they stay comfortable through long listening sessions.
Bluetooth 5.3 keeps the connection steady and lets you switch between devices to take a call or watch a quick video.
Use the soundcore app to build your own EQ, choose from presets, play relaxing white noise and more.
